_tier: Tier A: map IDs, widths, original_life and the three bosses from v83 Map.wz / Mob.wz. Tier C: region, map order and pool rules (spec #449 C7, ticket #469, progression step 12), the 900 s duration and every pacing value, which copy Sleepywood's keyframe numbers (rate, max_alive, hp, speed), bursts, elites, exp_mult and hard_cap exactly (Sleepywood carries no post_duration_slope). Only the pools differ, and there is no opening_ramp: level_scale takes its place. Keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).

_level_scale: Tier C (#469, #449 first draft): pasted from level_scale_draft.gd --step=12 --stage=zipangu, not tuned. exp_level(t) is Sleepywood's effective level E_sw at each keyframe time, and level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (12 - 5), so every region levels the character at Sleepywood's pace and this step is twenty-one effective levels harder. Without it the stage would run its canonical monsters at full strength from 0:00 for a Lv1 character. C13 (#475, tier C, calibrated on training seeds 1-4): level(t) = lerp(1, E_sw(t) + 5.25, min(1, t/600)): the stage starts at effective level 1 and reaches this step's level at 10:00, because a Lv1 character cannot take Lv15-and-up damage from the first second; 5.25 levels above Sleepywood here (0.75 per step to step 12, 0.25 per step after it: the first draft's +3 per step out-ran what a band's equipment adds).
